notes.title: 🏆 🚀 Exciting Update: Leaderboards Are Finally Here! 🚀🏆
notes.notes:
🎉🏆 [b]v1.5.0 - Leaderboards!![/b] 🏆🎉

🏆 🚀 [b]Exciting Update: Leaderboards Are Finally Here![/b] 🚀🏆

I'm thrilled to announce that the[b] leaderboard [/b]display feature is now [b]live![/b] 🏆 You can now view the top players and their scores directly within the game as well as your own rank of course. This addition will make it easier to track and compare your performance with others!

[b]Here's what you can expect:[/b]

⏰ [b]Real-time Leaderboards:[/b] See the [b]top global scores[/b] across different categories.

[b]Offline Mode:[/b] Enjoy offline play and feel good about pushing your progress! It will be uploaded to the leaderboard next time you launch in online mode.

🏊‍♂️ Dive into the game and check out the [b]new leaderboard [/b]feature today! Your [b]high scores[/b] could be next on the list! 🌟🏆🚀

notes.title: 🎉 v1.4.0 - Customization Update is Live! 🎉
notes.notes:
🎉 [b]v1.4.0 - Customization Update is Live![/b] 🎉

🎊 Bringing you a [b]massive[/b] drop of new [b]Customization[/b] content! Jump back in and explore all the new features. Customize, [b]upgrade[/b], and enjoy the enhanced gaming experience! Plus, we're adding [b]5 new achievements[/b] for you to unlock! 🏆✨

🥇 [b]Achievements[/b] 🥇
[b]Five new achievements[/b] to go for, including a brand [b]new secret[/b] achievement! 
- [b]Stage Complete [100, 250, 500, 1000][/b] have been added
- [b]Secret Achievement[/b] added 🏆🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066817/953830846ecaa3e30de7b8fe72654df9beb82191.png[/img]

🌈 [b]Border Colors | RAINBOW+[/b] 🌈 
Personalize your game with [b]8 new border colors[/b] for your game! Make it uniquely yours and stand out in style! [b]➡️ | 🟥 | 🟧 | 🟨 | 🟩 | 🟦 | 🟪 | Maroon | Magical Teal |[/b]

🌟 [b]Score Frame Customization[/b] 🌟
You can now [b]customize[/b] the [b]score frame[/b]! [b]New frames[/b] will likely be added in the near future as well! 

📣 [b]Sound Effects[/b] 📣
You can now [b]unlock[/b] additional [b]sound effects[/b] for a total of [b]8[/b] to choose from! ✨🎮
📚  Page Flip
💣  8bit Bomb
🏴‍☠️  Arrrr [Pirate]
✖️  Error
💥  Explode
💓  Heartbeat

💦  Splat

notes.title: 🚨🚨 Major Pixel Flip Update 🚨🚨
notes.notes:
🚨🚨 [b]Release Date![/b] 🚨🚨

I plan to release for Monday (Wednesday latest)!

We will start with 100 pixeldex cards to match and hunt for. Jam packed with 75 achievements! 

Will you be the ultimate pixel collector?


[b]Soon After Release[/b]
Sadly the leaderboards will not be a part of release as I had initally wanted. They are not supported with python. I am currently looking into a work around.

- Potentially Getting Leaderboards (In that event, all private scores earned since release will be uploaded to the leaderboard. You will not start at 0.) [Ill be pushing hard for this!]
- Polish Item Store & Add Additional Items / Categories
- Improve UI 
- Look into New and Interesting Ways to Interact With Your Pixeldex
- Much Much More
